title: Poocha Laila ne ke Zainab Kya Hua Akbar Mera
body:
Poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera, boli Zainab ye tadapkar margaya beta mera
Jis ghadi ran ke liye Akbar gaye kohraam tha, tha qayamat ka samaan mehshar ka ek hangaam tha, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Qalb-e-Akbar chhid gaya barchi ka phal seene mein hain , umme laila kya jiye ab kya maza jine mein hain, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Maut bhi muh pher kar rone lagi shabbir per, tashnalab ran mein tadapkar margaya sheh ka pisar, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehgaye tanha shahe deen margaya kadyal jawaan, kistarha laash ko laate dil pa khabo tha kahaan, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Ab kahan deedar-e-Akbar ho bhala laila tujhe, maut ke shera mein ja kar laal ye so jayega, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Khoon jitna hain kaleje mein mere behjayega, phal ye barchi ka kaleje mein sada rehjayega, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Beh raha hai umme laila ke jigar ka ab lahoo , haye ek poori hui na bibiyoon ki arzoo, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Dee sada bachchon ko aur kaha hamsheer se, laashe Akbar uthana payegi bahen shabbir se, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
Nouha ye Iqbal likha tishna lab Akbar tera, kahke phal barchi ka ran se haye tu pyasa gaya, poochha laila ne ke Zainab kya hua Akbar mera
